scope_note: Names and definitions identify the programme and development scope. They do not establish a completed game, validated model, biological or clinical capability.
release_policy: Work is published here while it is still experimental, with its version, sources and limits stated. Privacy, redistribution rights, security and an honest statement of scientific scope are required of everything published.
license_note: Project-owned contributions CC0-1.0; third-party materials retain their own rights and notices.
development_status: active; work has resumed alongside NeuroSurge and Interoceptomics
programme_focus: NeuroTranslation, NeuroSurge and Interoceptomics are active together.

data_companion.version: 2026-11-20 recording readers with population rise and fall corrections
data_companion.meaning: Import and inspect recordings locally. Replay the fit made on first recordings (R1), or compare the fixed and personally calibrated models on an imported second recording (R2). Complete R2 trials are checked against their archived sample clock and the four input streams the study used. Group results are shown separately.
data_companion.hosting: Static files in docs/ on the main branch, served by GitHub Pages.

navigation_overlay.scope: The recording-source chooser is part of the app. The general CSV and JSON inspector remains available.
navigation_overlay.source_count_scope: Seven recording-reader choices in the app. Two use the CEMHSEY pinch recordings for different studies.

papers.scope: The current edition, 20 November 2026: NeuroTranslation (53 pages, Simple English Edition 63) and Brain2Body (29 pages, Simple English Edition 33), working drafts not reviewed outside the project. NeuroTranslation reports every study of the numbered table, 1 to 29, with a row for each in its appendix B.
papers.build_provenance: Four PDFs built offline with the Tectonic 0.17 TeX engine; a rebuild from the source ZIP gives the same bytes.
papers.source_status: The complete source of the four PDFs (91 files: TeX, bibliography, figure, fonts and tools), the build script, and the ledger and small result files its number check reads. The TeX engine and its package files are named in the ZIP, not included.
papers.publication_scope: This block identifies the files of the current edition.

historical_scientific_layout.scope: The 15 November 2026 edition: four drafts, 546 pages, of which 26 had a recorded visual check. The current edition replaced it; the link shows it in the repository history.
historical_scientific_layout.build_provenance: The two technical PDFs came from the previous build; the two Simple English PDFs were rebuilt, and the rebuilt Brain2Body one was byte-identical to its predecessor.

download_bundle.scope: Four PDFs, three companion files, README, manifest and five notice files; no font, source or model files.

historical_scientific_layout.source_status: No matching source was published with that edition.

portable_interface.status: Source only: no model weights, no download, nothing that runs, not a finished interface.

wrist_pointing.source_rights: CC BY 4.0, attribution included in each benchmark.
wrist_pointing.cohort_scope: Six training, three development participants; 1,879 eligible training trials and 960 eligible development trials, with six reserved participants.
wrist_pointing.scope_note: The interactive controls change explicitly invented features. Reported errors describe separate, fixed analyses of the measured pointing task at a nominal 250 ms forecast horizon; physical latency is unmeasured.

wrist_pointing_forecasts.comparison_scope: Six training participants with 1,879 eligible recorded trials; three different development participants supplied 960 complete trials. 250 ms forecast horizon on the archive clock. The reserved test recordings remain unopened.

recorded_trial_replay.verification_scope: Fingerprints cover all six input windows, measured two-axis targets, archive and clock metadata for all 960 original development trials. Six trained temporal checkpoints execute in the browser. Cohort errors and individual recorded trials have separate views. The 250 ms lead refers to stored rows; device delays are unverified.
recorded_trial_replay.public_contents: Public artifact contains aggregate scores, fitted models, code and checksums; the reader supplies a trial locally.
recorded_trial_replay.limits: Verified on Linux Chromium with hosted, offline and emulated narrow-screen cases. No recordings from the reserved test group are included or were examined.

wrist_forearm_transfer.scope: Six training participants, three previously evaluated development participants, six reserved test participants not examined.

uji_forearm_emg.scope: Offline healthy-volunteer daily activities. Participant-specific reference posture, retrospectively filtered wrist-angle targets. Observations from the four final test volunteers were not evaluated.

daily_wrist_browser.scope: Estimates of retrospectively filtered glove angles in offline daily-activity trials. The interface runs two fixed estimators and a weighted combination on invented or compatible local inputs. The weights were chosen using training data only. The four development participants had been studied before, and the final test participants are still unopened.

way_grip_force.scope: Offline voluntary pinch-lift force forecasting. Aligned scalp EEG slightly reduced equal-person development RMSE versus mechanical history. The phase-matched EEG model did better than aligned EEG.

browser.input_scope: Original single windows, invented trial replay, and compatible locally converted WAY-EEG-GAL WS trials. Four displayed predictors use preceding sensor samples. Twenty-nine separately stored later grip forces can be revealed to score each forecast. The browser ZIP contains no participant samples.

way_contact_force.scope: Two offline grip-force forecasts compared after the tenth consecutive sample at or above 0.5 N on the 500 Hz recording clock. Adding aligned scalp EEG increased average error in both families on the same development group, which had been looked at before. The final test group is still unopened. The launchers use invented input by default.

browser.scope: Fixed ridge and causal CNN weights run on the same prior window. An invented example or compatible local JSON supplies inputs. A future target sample can be shown only when supplied. Rotation is an aggregate control. The 120 ms horizon is on the recording clock.

browser.trial_replay: One right-hand trial per local file; 205 scheduled cutoffs, conditional on complete input and target support. The example is invented.
browser.signal_plot: Twenty 50 Hz transducer readings and a selectable forecast at +120 ms. Trial outcomes are shown only when revealed.

hygrip_force.scope: First scoring of three original HYGRIP development participants after public protocol posting. The browser uses fixed fits from the training group and invented example inputs by default. The final test group is still unopened.

secondary_emg.tested_endpoint: forecast of released sensor voltage 120 ms after issue
secondary_emg.scope: Secondary right-hand analysis on the same three previously studied development people. Timing-specific forearm EMG and scalp EEG directional screens failed on the training group and on the development group.

study.scope: Index-finger sensor voltage on a distinct two-day isometric task. Physical real-time lead remains unverified.
study.decision: Aligned EMG gave no average gain on the main measure in this experiment; results for each held-out participant and each day are reported.

hyser_index.scope: Released index transducer voltage 120 ms ahead on the nominal stream. Four final participants reserved. No online or clinical claim.

crossday_study.scope: Matched Day 1 supervised calibration on an output offset and gain, followed by fixed Day 2 scoring. Shared model had the lowest mean Day 2 MAE on the four development participants, who had been studied before. Paired-donor control and pair-level descriptive uncertainty are reported.

hyser_index.personal_reader: Two original same-person session folders, five labeled first-day trials, fixed second-day inference. Population mode remains available.

whole_hand.scope: Five force sensors, four prespecified fits including one other-trial control, and three same-trial predictors. MAE favored different models in the 12-person training comparison and four previously studied development participants. Reserved final participants remain unopened.

prescribed_task.scope: Unchanged Random-task weights scored on 360 prescribed N-DoF trials in 12 original fit participants and 120 in four previously evaluated development participants. Across all combinations, persistence gave lowest MAE and five histories lowest RMSE in each group. No refits. Original final participants remain excluded.

cemhsey_pinch.scope: Offline normalized scalar P200 pinch-force recording. Three fit participants over two days, four different evaluation participants on different indexed days. The public reader includes an invented model and supports local fit import; the study fit stays private. No cross-device physical availability or individual finger force inference.

cemhsey_intervals.status: Measured comparison of pooled and cue-phase widths on held-out trials; the public single-trial example uses invented values.

cemhsey_original_browser.support: Duplicate CEMHSEY GRASP Session 5 Task 2 recordings are detected from the decoded contents of the local files. Training, interval calibration and evaluation use separate recordings.

cemhsey_force_transfer.status: Second-repeat evaluation independently reproduced across three targets.
cemhsey_force_transfer.limitations: Four previously studied adults, one indexed day, fixed repeat order and nominal timing; public examples and bundled weights are invented.

cemhsey_day_transfer.status: Second repeats on the next indexed day, scored independently; the set of source recordings was checked.
cemhsey_day_transfer.limitations: One pair of indexed days, four previously studied participants, one prescribed task and nominal 120 ms timing. Public reader uses invented signals and weights by default.

cemhsey_population_phase.status: Six test records scored on an independent group, then independently reproduced. Public ranges rounded outward under the reporting rule set before the results were seen.
cemhsey_population_phase.limitations: Three fitting and three separate evaluation participants; one target on one indexed day. Other records from these people were known in prior studies. Forecast horizon uses nominal indices.

hygrip_force.status: Finished. The three development participants were first scored after the protocol was published; the results are in experimental_previews.hygrip_force. The final test group is still unopened.
hygrip_force.scope: Cued right-hand power grip in a separate dataset. Target is a transducer-voltage reading 120 ms ahead on the released clock.

hygrip_cue_phase.scope: Comparison of cue-conditioned and shared voltage dynamics on the previously studied healthy HYGRIP cohort.
hygrip_cue_phase.outcome: The phase-conditioned residual did not beat the original full-history benchmark on either split. Previously studied development cohort. The full-history ridge stays the chosen model.

hyser_index.scope: Index-finger sensor voltage on a distinct two-day isometric task. Physical real-time lead remains unverified.
hyser_index.decision: Aligned EMG gave no average gain on the main measure in this experiment; results for each held-out participant and each day are reported.

Shared model had the lowest mean Day 2 MAE on the four development participants, who had been studied before. Paired-donor control and pair-level descriptive uncertainty are reported.

hyser_whole_hand.scope: Five force sensors, four prespecified fits including one other-trial control, and three same-trial predictors. MAE favored different models in the 12-person training comparison and four previously studied development participants. Reserved final participants remain unopened.

Across all combinations, persistence gave lowest MAE and five histories lowest RMSE in each group. No refits. Original final participants remain excluded.

cemhsey_force_transfer.status: Second-repeat evaluation independently reproduced across three targets.
cemhsey_force_transfer.limitations: Four previously studied adults, one indexed day, fixed repeat order and nominal timing; public examples and bundled weights are invented.

cemhsey_day_transfer.status: Second repeats on the next indexed day, scored independently; the set of source recordings was checked.
cemhsey_day_transfer.limitations: One pair of indexed days, four previously studied participants, one prescribed task and nominal 120 ms timing. Public reader uses invented signals and weights by default.

prospective_studies_note: Studies entered here when they were planned. All eleven now have results, given or linked in each entry; none is still waiting to be run.

calibrated_fingers_and_knee_moments.scope: Five participants with different cortical recording layouts contributed to calibrated finger-transfer comparisons. Seven walkers fitted and three tested the knee-moment model. The two studies use separate people, clocks and units.
